name: Mako Grill
description: Charcoal chicken, jollof and khebab grill with two Accra branches, in charcoal, pepper red and amber on cream with heavy condensed Archivo headings. Home has a hero plate inside a rotating text ring with a price stamp, weekly deals as perforated order tickets, round dish photos, a tabbed menu board with spice meters and allergen codes, a scrolling word band, a weekend deal with a live countdown to Sunday 22:00 Accra time, three ways to order, Google reviews and a catering band. Menu is a full HTML menu in GH₵ with sticky section links and filters (vegetarian, mild, no groundnut). Catering has priced party packs and an event enquiry form. About, Contact (two branches with open-now status and hours) and a photo credits page. An order dialog hands off to WhatsApp, Bolt Food, Glovo or a call; no cart. Layout ideas from a fast-food theme; reference screenshots in inspiration/.
